title: Three Years and One Short Lever
subtitle: 战争和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：tank　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tank 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the engineer ① filled the tank that no worker in the workshop would have recorded, and he said the filling was the whole of the year. The ② tank, meaning the container itself and not the lever, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a tank, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ tank in that workshop had the same short lever beside it, and the ④ tank at the far bench, meaning the part they kept for the children to fit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A tank, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the engineer said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tank was the whole of the matter, meaning the strength and not the container. The ⑥ tank, meaning the strength and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; tank, he said, is either something you fill or the only word that means both a container and a strength. He said the strength is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ tank had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short lever. The ⑧ tank of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in April, was one workshop and three years of recording; tank, he said, is either the part at the far bench or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tank I remember is the container recorded in the manual, which closed in 1977 and is still recorded as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ tank, my mother said in 1979, is the only container that improves by being recorded; every tank, she said, is a strength that has agreed to look like a container. She said the strength was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 坦克；水箱（指车间里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 坦克；水箱（指那个坦克本身，与短短的拉杆相对）
C. 固定搭配：fill the tank 装满这一个坦克
D. n. 坦克；水箱（指留给孩子们装的那一件）
E. n. 坦克之事（抽象总称，指一处车间的坦克之事）
F. n. 坦克；水箱（指说明书里写到、被记载的那一个）
G. n. 坦克、厚重（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 厚重（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: filled the tank that no worker in the workshop would have recorded
The tank, meaning the container itself and not the lever
the tank at the far bench
the tank was the whole of the matter
the tank had become a line in a manual
The tank of the whole thing
A tank, my mother said in 1979

answers.why: fill the tank 意为“装满这一个坦克”，1970 年那位工程师把车间里没有一位工人肯记载的一个坦克做了一遍。
tank 意为“坦克；水箱”，指那个坦克本身而不是短短的拉杆，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
tank 意为“坦克；水箱”，指车间里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一根短短的拉杆。
tank 意为“坦克；水箱”，指最远那张工作台的留给孩子们装的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tank 意为“坦克、厚重”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个厚重就是那件事的全部。
tank 意为“厚重”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个坦克，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tank 意为“坦克；水箱”，指说明书里写到、被记载的那一个，到 1975 年这一个成了说明书里的一行。
tank 意为“坦克之事”，工程师四月写道，整件事的坦克之事是一处车间和三个年头的记载。
tank 意为“坦克；水箱”，我记得的是说明书里记载过的那一个，1977 年装好了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一个。
tank 为抽象总称，母亲 1979 年说，坦克是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的坦克。
